chunks: This because you laughed at God's revelations and were taken in by the life of the world." So they will neither be taken out of it, nor will be asked to seek God's favour on that day.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for those who mocked God's revelations and were deceived by worldly life?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the finality of divine retribution for those who treated Allah's signs as a subject of ridicule, emphasizing that worldly life's deception leads to a state where no further opportunity for repentance (istitab) remains. The phrase 'la yukhrajuna minha' is interpreted not only as remaining in Hell but also as being confined within it without exit, reflecting the severity of their spiritual stagnation. This condition serves as a warning against superficial engagement with revelation, a theme central to the concept of *Ghurur* (deception) in Shia moral theology.
